title: NNSA accepted operating capacity receives mirror and redirect integrity enforcement
summary: Mirrors must preserve the exact representation and release-index digests, declare the canonical URI, enforce transport security, and use a single permanent redirect with no downgrade, query injection, fragment injection, loop, or transform. Denominator: One contract-specific mirror and redirect schema, eighteen adversarial cases, five bounded valid routes, thirteen explicit rejections, and zero actual mirror or redirect events recorded.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Mirror and redirect integrity controls.
